description: This is a unit test class for 'AclEntryModifiedStrategy' in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests the immutability of the strategy class and its correct application of an 'AclEntryModified' event to a 'Thing' object.

classes.name: AclEntryModifiedStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for 'AclEntryModifiedStrategy', verifying immutability and event application correctness.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the 'AclEntryModifiedStrategy' class instances are immutable.

methods.name: appliesEventCorrectly
methods.description: Tests that the strategy correctly applies an 'AclEntryModified' event to a 'Thing' object and results in the expected state.
